scope: Official public requirements only; no portal login or submission performed

rules.value: International Journal of Biomedical Engineering and Technology; IJBET; Inderscience; ISSN print 1752-6418, online 1752-6426
Original paper appropriate; journal essentials exclude briefs/research notes
Online submission through Inderscience Submissions and Peer-Review System; do not use obsolete email-submission workflow
Double-blind. Main file excludes author names, affiliations, biographical notes and acknowledgements; remove authors from file properties. Retain title, abstract and keywords.
Submission file PDF. Supply editable Word as preparation source/if portal requests additional files.
Factual and precise; fewer than 150 words; objective, methods and conclusions; avoid references/uncommon abbreviations
Approximately 10–15 words or phrases
Normally 5000–7000 words, excluding figures, tables and references; high-quality articles above 7000 may be considered
English with UK spelling and terminology
Times New Roman 12 preferred; either single or double spacing accepted
Harvard author–date in text; detailed alphabetical reference list; full authors, publication details, DOI where available; web references include actual access date and URL
Position, department, institution, full postal address and email per author; biographical note approximately100 words, maximum150. Details belong in online author fields, not anonymous main article.
Sequential figures at end of article. Black and white preferred; colour permitted online, print is black and white. High-quality readable artwork.
No numeric dpi threshold or mandatory TIFF/EPS format on current preparation page. 300dpi PNG and vector PDF/SVG are preparation choices, not claimed journal requirements.

Word/LaTeX templates optional; production typesetter formats accepted papers. Small single-column and A4 double-column options exist; journal allocation list did not render, so IJBET-specific template size not verified.
All articles include conflict-of-interest declaration

Research involving human participants requires informed-consent declaration, including anonymised data; specify original consent or organisation/reason for waiver. Do not infer waiver merely from ethics-review exemption.
Current webpage requires AI technology and purpose disclosed in Declarations. Responsibility remains with human authors; AI cannot be an author.
Definitive author order, affiliations and corresponding author agreed; all authors read and agree to submitted content

Four subject experts with names, full addresses and expertise; none from any authors institution or on any Inderscience editorial board; at least two from a different country from the authors. Personal relationship status cannot be assumed.

Formal written rejection/withdrawal evidence for prior same/substantially similar submissions; after submission, author emails evidence with new submissionID to submissions@inderscience.com. Preparation only; no message sent by agent.
May prepare editorial letter and notes; current public checklist does not require a separate cover-letter file. Older email workflow differs and is not controlling.
No standard publication charge unless OA is requested; no payment action authorised/performed
